name: Colossus Beneath the Shelf
text:
Trample
Colossus Beneath the Shelf enters the battlefield tapped with ten stun counters on it. (If it would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
As long as Colossus Beneath the Shelf is tapped, it has hexproof and indestructible.
Whenever a snow land enters the battlefield under your control, remove a stun counter from Colossus Beneath the Shelf.
Whenever you cast a snow spell, remove a stun counter from Colossus Beneath the Shelf.
